RecipeDef.label: Build frigate
RecipeDef.description: The frigate is one of the most basic warship types. It is armed and can engage enemies.

RecipeDef.label: Build torpedo boat
RecipeDef.description: The torpedo boat is an advanced derivative of the frigate, dedicated to launching torpedoes. They are slower and more fragile, but can deliver devastating strikes against large targets.

RecipeDef.label: Build destroyer
RecipeDef.description: Destroyers use a two-section design, allowing a wide variety of strategic armaments.

RecipeDef.label: Build cruiser
RecipeDef.description: Cruisers use a three-section design and can be freely refitted with additional modules if one is willing to pay.

RecipeDef.label: Build battleship
RecipeDef.description: Battleships carry unmatched firepower and have the largest hull size, but they are expensive and poorly maneuverable.

RecipeDef.label: Build titan
RecipeDef.description: These giant warships are the pride of the fleet. Titans carry a variety of weapons and usually serve as flagships.

RecipeDef.label: Build juggernaut
RecipeDef.description: These colossal constructs are both ships and space stations. The juggernaut is an enormous mobile station that can repair and build ships, serving as a forward base during offensive campaigns.
